2.3.31 Report.PageHeight
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.PageHeight element specifies the default height of each rendered Page of a Report in a
physical-page oriented renderer. The Report.PageHeight element is optional. If this element is
present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "11in".
Following is the parent element of the Report.PageHeight element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.PageHeight element.
 <xsd:element name="PageHeight" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
